output.summary: A small tree native to Brazil, strawberry guava has oval leaves and thin-skinned fruit ranging from yellow to dark red or purple. Its juicy fruit and skin are edible, fresh or made into jam and juice, although removing the skin gives a sweeter flavour. It is highly invasive in many tropical regions.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit's skin and juicy interior are edible; it is eaten fresh or made into jam and juice, sometimes after removing the skin.
